svg.title: 推荐技术方案 · 媒体流水线与可恢复审核 · 分片解析、状态恢复与多模态推理
svg.desc: 推荐方案：优先建设媒体处理和模型端点的分层调度。大型模型服务独立扩容，量化或微调需另做权重、硬件与多模态质量评估。；素材接入与任务调度：Video Task API，Python / Material Reference，Stream Window / Task ID；Media Task Queue，Celery / Redis，Worker Routing / Retry，Idempotent Segment Tasks；媒体解析与时间对齐：FFmpeg Worker，Docker / FFmpeg，Window Slicing / Frame Sampling，Audio Track Extraction；Speech / Text Worker，ASR / OCR Adapter，Timestamped Transcript，Frame Text / Product Content；Temporal Evidence Index，Object Storage / Media URI，Segment ID / Start / End，Frame / Transcript Alignment；核查状态与模型容量：LangGraph Audit Graph，StateGraph / Conditional Routing，Segment State / Skill Checks，Evidence Aggregation；Persistent Checkpointer，PostgreSQL / thread_id，Checkpoint / Resume，Processed Segment State；Multimodal Model Endpoint，qwen3.6-397b / HTTPX，Concurrency / Request Budget，Timeout / Endpoint Capacity；片段证据与运行观测：Temporal Evidence Report，Issue / Rule / Segment Citation，Frames / Transcript / Product，Reviewable Media Links；Pipeline Observability，Langfuse，Queue Wait / Node Latency，Model Usage / Failed Segments；01 Video Task API → Media Task Queue：素材引用与分片任务；02 Media Task Queue → FFmpeg Worker：按工作容量分配媒体任务；03 FFmpeg Worker → Speech / Text Worker：音轨 / 抽样帧 / 时间戳；04 FFmpeg Worker → Temporal Evidence Index：媒体片段与存储引用；05 Speech / Text Worker → Temporal Evidence Index：口播 / 画面文字 / 时间索引；06 Temporal Evidence Index → LangGraph Audit Graph：对齐后的多模态核查上下文；07 LangGraph Audit Graph ↔ Persistent Checkpointer：保存执行状态 / 断点恢复；08 LangGraph Audit Graph ↔ Multimodal Model Endpoint：片段推理请求 / 核查结果；09 LangGraph Audit Graph → Temporal Evidence Report：核查结论与片段证据；10 LangGraph Audit Graph → Pipeline Observability：图路径 / 模型调用 / 节点状态；11 Media Task Queue → Pipeline Observability：排队时长 / 重试与失败分片
